gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Noto Sans Coptic keeps its weight in the middle of the line, with open mouths on the s and c. And Junegull, cut from one gauge of tubing with its curves pinched closed, is the stubborn one of the two.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-cuneifo: Junegull has a lowercase built like cast iron capitals, with curves that pinch nearly shut. Noto Sans Cuneiform goes the other way, its e opening wide and its lowercase swollen like glass beads.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-devanag: Junegull's lowercase stands about as tall as cast iron capitals, with every curve pinched at the mouth and no thick-thin flicker. Noto Sans Devanagari opens the g wide.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-duploya: Noto Sans Duployan reads wide and generous, with a gaping mouth on the a and oversized counters. Junegull is the tighter one, closed and chunky, while Noto Sans Duployan lets the text breathe.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Junegull's pinched curves and cast-iron lowercase give it a retro, friendly stubbornness. But Noto Sans Elbasan, with big lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut, would carry a long passage without tiring.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads open throughout, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Junegull earns its keep big and brief, where those pinched, closed curves can show off.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-ethiopi: Friendly and retro, Junegull keeps its curves thick right through the shoulders and pinches them shut. Noto Sans Ethiopic sets that against a tall, sturdy lowercase whose c terminals hang far from the bowl.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-georgia: Chunky, closed and a bit retro. Junegull does its best work with that pinched, cast-iron lowercase, while Noto Sans Georgian handles the reading with open curves and short ascender stems on tall bodies.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-glagoli: Retro and compass-drawn, Junegull pinches every curve shut and never flickers between thick and thin. Noto Sans Glagolitic follows with open round letters and a tall, sturdy lowercase that would read steadily.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Cast iron meets glass beads here: Junegull's lowercase is stout and pinched shut, while Noto Sans Gothic opens huge counters and round forms like parentheses. Expect a long page to feel spacious.
